mechanics_change_policy: Any mechanics, cohort, route, cap, reasoning policy, seed lineage, or analysis change requires a committed preregistration amendment before v5 model data is observed.

statistical_panel_design.primary_claim: Every registered model-plus-compact-scaffold system trails deterministic pick-trader on seed-paired mean lift under the frozen sota-v5 mechanics.
statistical_panel_design.target_effect_basis: Unchanged from the 2026-08-16 preregistration and still conservative against the frozen sota-v2 observed lifts. No v5 or v6 model result exists to tune it.
statistical_panel_design.cross_model_covariance: Compound symmetry: one shared residual lift-seed draw per seed; model-by-seed interaction and repeat-averaged noise are independent by model.

selected_allocation.allocation_selection_note: 29 seeds x 1 repeat is the frozen v6 panel width from docs/bench_v6_spec.md, set by the minimum detectable difference target (30 points) rather than by this lane's earlier familywise-power search. docs/scoring_calibration.md measures a 26-point MDD at 29 paired seeds against a paired-residual SD of 40.1 and an assumed within-seed repeat SD of 15.0. Widening the family from 8 to 16 tightens the Holm first step from 0.00625 to 0.003125; the exact sign-flip floor at 29 seeds is 2/2**29 = 3.73e-09, which clears it by six orders of magnitude, so the wider family costs nothing in feasibility.
selected_allocation.supersedes: The 16-seed x 1-repeat allocation frozen on 2026-08-16, which was carried forward from sota-v3 with an unused private commitment. That commitment is retired unused; see seed_panel.

statistical_panel_design.selection_rule: The v6 panel width is fixed at 29 paired seeds by the minimum-detectable-difference target in docs/bench_v6_spec.md and the calibration in docs/scoring_calibration.md. This lane's earlier smallest-allocation-clearing-0.80-familywise-power search is superseded: it optimized a different quantity (all-reject power against a -100 planning effect) on a narrower family.
statistical_panel_design.lineage: The 2026-08-16 lane carried a 16-seed allocation and commitment forward from sota-v3 and sota-v4. Neither lane ever ran a panel and no seed or salt was read, so retiring that commitment reveals nothing and costs no measurement.
statistical_panel_design.within_seed_variance_caveat: The 26-point projection assumes a within-seed model repeat SD near 15.0. Saved v5-era leaderboard artifacts span 19.9 to 56.7 on that statistic. Every published row records within_seed_score_stddev, and no separation claim is made for a pair whose noisier member exceeds 25.

seed_panel.name: private-env
seed_panel.owner_attestation_scope: Owner must attest that the new 29-seed commitment and its seed values are unused, that no earlier panel read them, and that panel execution will use the exact committed values without post-data substitution.

retired_commitment.retired_because: It commits to 16 seeds and the v6 panel is 29. It was never used and its seeds were never read, so it is retired rather than revealed; its digests are kept here so the retirement is checkable. It must not be reused, extended, or partially revealed.

seed_panel.blocked_on: scripts/seed_panel_commitment.py generate --lane config/sota_v5_lane.json --secret-file <path outside the checkout>, then committing the returned sha256 and hiding_commitment_sha256 here and setting status to frozen. Generating private seed material and choosing its escrow is an owner action, so it is deliberately not done by this amendment; panel execution stays blocked until it is.

output_policy_amendment_rule: The 4,096-token ceiling is frozen. Cap pressure on a single row excludes that row from the panel with its evidence retained; it does not raise the cap and does not silently re-run the row at a larger budget. No result-informed cap amendment is authorized.
fallback_output_token_cap_status: Recorded for schema compatibility only. Under this amendment no fallback branch is authorized: the cap is frozen at 4,096 and a pressured row is excluded rather than re-run at 8,192.
blockers: A new 29-seed private panel must be generated, committed, and frozen; the retired 16-seed commitment is the wrong width and must not be reused.
The authenticated zero-completion route and privacy preflight must accept all sixteen registered routes; the committed acceptance is for the withdrawn eight-model cohort under a stale fingerprint.
The final-fingerprint preflight evidence must be regenerated against a600b7da0c302231.
An owner attestation is required before hidden seed access and panel authorization.
Every required strict smoke must be accepted before a separate panel decision.
SOTA-v2, v3 and v4 remain terminal historical contracts and cannot be reopened or used to select anything here.

final_preflight_evidence.stale_because: The committed artifact is digested against contract fingerprint 247e12fe5a7d4f5b, the withdrawn eight-model cohort, and the $10 smoke-only ceiling. Its sha256 is deliberately not restated here: regenerating the artifact is authenticated panel-time work and this amendment makes no acceptance claim about it.
